races.name: David Clarke Memorial 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RIDE LIKE A GIRL holds the clear edge on form and looks to have been found a good opportunity to bag a second success over hurdles. Tom George has his string in excellent nick and his Worcester bumper scorer Dark Tide Rising appeals as the one to chase home Jamie Snowden's mare ahead of fellow hurdling newcomer Whin Cover.

  1. RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR)
  2. DARK TIDE RISING (IRE)
  3. WHIN COVER

races.name: Martin Bowler Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This can go DANTE'S INFERNO, who was clear of the remainder when a close second at Market Rasen last week and can race off the same mark here. Drumlee Myth and Knockeranna Rose may give him most to think about.

  1. DANTE'S INFERNO
  2. DRUMLEE MYTH (IRE)
  3. KNOCKERANNA ROSE (IRE)

races.name: Jewson Hexham Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE and Mr Mcloughlan may battle this out for a pair of in-form yards, the former narrowly preferred on the pick of last season's efforts. Banderas appeals most of the remainder.

  1. MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE (IRE)
  2. MR MCLOUGHLAN
  3. BANDERAS (IRE)

races.name: El Tel's 61 Racecourse's & Done Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Course regular LES'S LEGACY lurks on a dangerous mark and gets the nod over interesting Irish raider Coded Welder, who's likely to be popular in the market with Sean Bowen booked. Glory And Honour also needs to be considered back in calmer waters.

  1. LES'S LEGACY
  2. CODED WELDER (IRE)
  3. GLORY AND HONOUR (IRE)

races.name: Heath RUFC A-Safe Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
There should be an honest gallop despite the small field, and it could set up perfectly for FRISKY WHISKEY to go one better than at Cartmel last time. Stylish Recruit and Scottish Dancer are both weighted to go well in their respective bids for a double.

  1. FRISKY WHISKEY
  2. STYLISH RECRUIT (IRE)
  3. SCOTTISH DANCER (IRE)

races.name: Davey Liddle Belated Birthday Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
With Soldier In Mayo's participation in doubt (declared at Southwell on Thursday), this may be best left to ILLOGICAL LOGIC, who made the perfect start for new connections at Cartmel recently and remains very well treated following a 3 lb nudge.

  1. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR)
  2. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE)
  3. JACK DOYEN (IRE)

races.name: Lee 'Bazza' Jenkinson Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
STAY HOPEFUL produced his best effort to date despite doing too much too soon in a first-time visor when third at Worcester in July and likely has more to offer for his new yard, with the booking of the Champion Jockey Sean Bowen also signalling intent. Uncle Al should be suited by a return to Hexham, while Valette also merits respect now going chasing.

  1. STAY HOPEFUL (IRE)
  2. UNCLE AL (IRE)
  3. VALETTE (IRE)

races.name: Autumn Racing Weekend Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Male Amateurs)
races.verdict:
This is wide open. TEX has gained both his victories here (first over C&D) and scored in good style in amateur company last time out so is fancied to defy a 6 lb weights rise with Simon Walker a significant booking. Recent Ffos Las winner Kaleidoscope Eyes heads the list of dangers under a 5-lb penalty, although Rock Opera is weighted to go well and represents last year's successful connections. Norcross Brow is another who can play a prominent role in his bid for a fourth win of 2026.

  1. TEX (FR)
  2. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)
  3. ROCK OPERA

races.name: BetMGM EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LEARNING continued her race-by-race progression when runner-up in a conditions event at Newbury a fortnight ago, giving a good account from the front, and she could be ready to get off the mark this time around. Pink Larkspur is feared most after her promising second at Kempton on debut, ahead of Concurrent.

  1. LEARNING
  2. PINK LARKSPUR (IRE)
  3. CONCURRENT

races.name: Colliers Business Rates Experts Classified Stakes (Str)
races.verdict:
With 3-y-os having an excellent recent record in this race, it may pay to concentrate on COCKADE and Princling, who have both won fresh previously. John & Thady Gosden's charge narrowly shades the vote, with Collecting Coin the pick of the older horses.

  1. COCKADE
  2. PRINCLING
  3. COLLECTING COIN

races.name: BetMGM Noel Murless Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
INFRAAD found another chunk of improvement when keeping on well for success in the Melrose at York and, with further progress still to come, he is taken to land the hat-trick up in grade. He gets the vote ahead of Galiyan, who quickly got back on track in the St Leger last time, while Galilean Quality can also give another good account.

  1. INFRAAD (IRE)
  2. GALIYAN
  3. GALILEAN QUALITY (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM Handicap
races.verdict:
The hat-trick seeking PILU has found improvement since taking on his elders and still looks on a workable mark. He gets the nod in an open-looking contest. Northcliff, Yordan and Far Above Dream make up the shortlist.

  1. PILU (IRE)
  2. NORTHCLIFF (IRE)
  3. YORDAN (IRE)

races.name: Melbourne Cup Carnival Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o CRANACHAN improved significantly for the stiffer test of stamina at Chester last time and remains relatively low mileage. He is fancied to go in again. Vaguely Royal and Just An Hour may provide the chief threat.

  1. CRANACHAN
  2. VAGUELY ROYAL (IRE)
  3. JUST AN HOUR (IRE)

races.name: Henry Malone 1926 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A tight-knit handicap but GEMINI MAN is proving very reliable this season and can gain a deserved fourth success on the back of a good recent C&D second. Millbuie is still searching for a first victory but arrives in good nick and could emerge as the main danger ahead of recent C&D scorer Koko Blue and the handily-weighted We've Got This.

  1. GEMINI MAN (IRE)
  2. MILLBUIE
  3. KOKO BLUE

races.name: Henry Malone 1926 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
KAMEEL has gained both his career wins here and is fancied to end a long losing sequence on the back of an unlucky-in-running second at Beverley last time out. Both Tiberio Force and Typeface arrive in good nick and can chase home Jessica Macey's 4-y-o in that order.

  1. KAMEEL
  2. TIBERIO FORCE
  3. TYPEFACE

races.name: H. Malone & Sons 100th Anniversary Nursery
races.verdict:
SON OF A FISH has advanced his form since sent handicapping and can race off the same mark as when a very good recent Redcar second so looks the way to go. Perfect Hope also arrives in excellent nick and should ensure Richard Hannon's colt doesn't have things all his own way, while in-form maiden Onslaught is another to consider.

  1. SON OF A FISH
  2. PERFECT HOPE
  3. ONSLAUGHT (IRE)

races.name: Aalberts Integrated Piping Systems Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NOOZHAA has plenty to live up to on pedigree being out of a Group 1 winner and she made a promising start when finishing second at Kempton 23 days ago, making late headway without being knocked about. She's expected to improve significantly for that initial experience and shades preference over the returning Maneuver, who appeals as the type to do better as a 3-y-o. Star Mirage can also be competitive.

  1. NOOZHAA
  2. MANEUVER
  3. STAR MIRAGE (USA)

races.name: Insulation Contractors Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ASHEYRA improved on her debut form despite still looking green when second in a small-field Ascot novice 4 weeks ago and almost certainly remaining capable of better, Roger Varian's filly makes plenty of appeal in her bid to make it third time lucky. High Threshold is an appealing newcomer from the Archie Watson stable and commands a second look, with Princeland expected to step forward from his Pontefract debut effort.

  1. ASHEYRA (IRE)
  2. HIGH THRESHOLD (IRE)
  3. PRINCELAND (IRE)

races.name: Armah Switchgear Handicap
races.verdict:
CABLE BEACH has made the frame 3 of his 4 starts this year, travelling well through the race when runner-up at Southwell last time, so is taken to open his account for the campaign. Finn Ironside is much respected, though, arriving on the back of a second C&D success, with Luminous Warrior another to consider.

  1. CABLE BEACH
  2. FINN IRONSIDE
  3. LUMINOUS WARRIOR (IRE)

races.name: Smith Brothers / H. Malone Handicap
races.verdict:
TRUCIAL PEARL took a step forward when scoring at Ripon in June, the runner-up winning 3 times since, and having not been ideally placed last time she could be up to doubling her tally. Soul Warrior is feared most following his recent Redcar success, while Forever Twenty shaped well over C&D on her penultimate start.

  1. TRUCIAL PEARL
  2. SOUL WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. FOREVER TWENTY

races.name: H. Malone Mechanical & Electrical Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for IZZARI, who confirmed the promise of his previous couple of starts when winning in good style at Southwell last week. Unpenalised for that success, he gets the vote ahead of King Sharja who does have to carry a penalty for his recent victory at the same course. Jamaican Storm is also capable of getting involved.

  1. IZZARI (GER)
  2. KING SHARJA
  3. JAMAICAN STORM

races.name: Pipes vs Wires Centenary Showdown Handicap
races.verdict:
It's feasible to think MAYO COUNTY will step forward from her recent Redcar third and, with cheekpieces refitted, she could well be ready to strike from a reduced mark. Recent C&D winner Get Up Everybody arrives in good heart and is feared, with Dance Fantasy and Coulsty Exchange others worthy of a second look.

  1. MAYO COUNTY
  2. GET UP EVERYBODY (IRE)
  3. DANCE FANTASY (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced 3-y-o AMALOU may be able to follow up her Windsor win if blinkers have the same effect. Arlecchino's Rex has rock-solid claims for a third course victory, while Tiger Beetle could be interesting off a falling mark with blinkers refitted.

  1. AMALOU
  2. ARLECCHINO'S REX
  3. TIGER BEETLE

races.name: Rockspur CIC EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LOWCOUNTRY went on the bridle longer than any bar the winner at this course 17 days ago and is taken to strike at the third time of asking with the drop to 5f looking a good move. Classic Bellini finished third at Wetherby in June and must enter the reckoning back from a break with her yard firmly amongst the winners, while Anna Belardo shouldn't be far away if reproducing his latest effort.

  1. LOWCOUNTRY
  2. CLASSIC BELLINI
  3. ANNA BELARDO

races.name: bet365 Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INKBERROW looked the winner for much of the straight on her C&D debut 17 days ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for her to get off the mark. Lahan Kingman and Ventana both hold claims on the pick of their form but come here on the back of poor runs.

  1. INKBERROW (IRE)
  2. LAHAN KINGMAN (IRE)
  3. VENTANA (IRE)

races.name: Franklin Hodge Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
NO RETURN has dropped to an attractive mark and the fitting of a visor can see him open his account for this yard. Style King can bounce back from a poor effort last time, with Pull The Rug another to consider providing she gets more luck.

  1. NO RETURN (IRE)
  2. STYLE KING (IRE)
  3. PULL THE RUG (IRE)

races.name: Franklin Hodge Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
QUEEN SANA bolted up sporting first-time cheekpieces in a Catterick maiden last month and returning to a handicap from just 1 lb higher, Ollie Sangster's filly is fancied to follow up at the expense of Campenaerts, who turned in his best effort since joining this yard when runner-up over C&D last time. Lamlash Bay has done most of his racing on turf but he can also feature if taking to the surface.

  1. QUEEN SANA
  2. CAMPENAERTS
  3. LAMLASH BAY

races.name: Nuvo Audit Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
QUIET SUMMER is the one open to progress and that may prove the decisive factor up against more exposed rivals that can all have a case made for them on their best form, though it may be that Last Verse proves the selection's biggest danger having taken well to all-weather recently.

  1. QUIET SUMMER (GER)
  2. LAST VERSE (IRE)
  3. ELSASS (IRE)

races.name: Appleby Mall Accountants Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several, but the vote goes to STAR OF MALI dropping back in grade. Red Hat Eagle arrives in form and should be in the mix, while He's A Gentleman will appreciate being eased in class also.

  1. STAR OF MALI (IRE)
  2. RED HAT EAGLE
  3. HE'S A GENTLEMAN (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ENCHANTED QUEEN was returning from almost a year off when making a winning debut for George Boughey at Kempton last month and remains with potential. She gets the nod. Great Mates may provide the chief threat.

  1. ENCHANTED QUEEN
  2. GREAT MATES
  3. BINTAZIZA (IRE)

races.name: Position Payout At bet365 Handicap
races.verdict:
BLACK CAB was a bit disappointing at Newcastle on his most recent outing in July but remains unexposed at 5f and is well worth another chance now returning to a track where he goes particularly well at. Fancy Dancer went down fighting at Bath last month and can go well again, while Spirited Dancer is also of interest having made an encouraging start for the Tony Carroll stable at the aforementioned venue.

  1. BLACK CAB (FR)
  2. FANCY DANCER
  3. SPIRITED DANCER

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
A wide-open sprint to kick things off and it could pay to take a chance on INISHMOT PRINCE, who should come on from his recent Laytown reappearance and perhaps more pertinently his usual visor is back on. Caffu Zafeen is sure to be popular arriving on a hat-trick, but he may have to settle for silver, with stable-switcher Blue Anthem and Happy Henry another couple worthy of consideration, too.

  1. INISHMOT PRINCE (IRE)
  2. CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE)
  3. BLUE ANTHEM

races.name: BAR 1 Casino 'Slot Games & Live Casino' Race
races.verdict:
He's only tried this trip once before but SIR LES PATTERSON seem sure to benefit from this return to synthetics and with his usual cheekpieces reapplied, Stephen Thorne's 5-y-o is put forward as the answer. His main danger may emerge from Eclairage, who has a cracking C&D record and carries a light weight partnered by a 7-lb apprentice. The Highway Rat is a regular in this race and he rounds off the shortlist.

  1. SIR LES PATTERSON
  2. ECLAIRAGE (IRE)
  3. THE HIGHWAY RAT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Legacy Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
BIG NEGOTIATOR has been thriving since the visor went on, winning twice at this level recently and the drop back to 5f shouldn't be an issue so she can continue her good spell with another win. Magical Moonlight has the potential to be her biggest threat but hasn't been seen for a while, Controlla and Shimmering Sun complete the shortlist.

  1. BIG NEGOTIATOR
  2. MAGICAL MOONLIGHT (IRE)
  3. SHIMMERING SUN (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
GOLDEN RING sets the clear standard and is the one they all have to beat in this maiden. Alaraza and the selection's stablemate Somebody Loves Me are newcomers who make plenty of appeal on pedigree but may have to settle for minor roles first time out.

  1. GOLDEN RING (IRE)
  2. ALARAZA (IRE)
  3. SOMEBODY LOVES ME

races.name: Michael And Esther Cooney Memorial Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
Joseph O'Brien had a nursery debutant win at the weekend and SNAPEQUUS is a similar type who makes most appeal in this field. Littlepacer looked a different prospect last time and can go well again, while Scarlet Dream will appreciate the step up in trip.

  1. SNAPEQUUS (IRE)
  2. LITTLEPACER (IRE)
  3. SCARLET DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Star Appeal Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
DEE'S FUNNY GIRL is the class act having been second in a Group 3 at Ascot in July and could well resume winning ways if bouncing back from a disappointing Deauville effort. Salt Lake is open to further improvement after winning at Naas 15 days ago and poses the main threat, while South Dakota showed an excellent attitude at Roscommon and could have more to offer.

  1. DEE'S FUNNY GIRL (IRE)
  2. SALT LAKE (IRE)
  3. SOUTH DAKOTA (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight' Maiden
races.verdict:
After a promising second here in August, EMIZA wasn't quite able to match that form upped to 1m at Navan last time, but she's well worth another chance back at 7f. She gets the vote ahead of Ready To Mingle, who could step forward from her recent stable debut, while Eleanor Shelby is interesting on first run for Joseph O'Brien.

  1. EMIZA (FR)
  2. READY TO MINGLE (IRE)
  3. ELEANOR SHELBY

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
AVIATRICE has gained all her 3 career victories here (including over C&D) and is fancied to bag a fourth now returned to this venue on the back of a good eighth in a big-field Leopardstown handicap last time. Mallavelly also has winning form here and rates the main threat, although Temperance is weighted to go well if back to her best and Bear On The Run remains with potential.

  1. AVIATRICE (IRE)
  2. MALLAVELLY (IRE)
  3. TEMPERANCE (IRE)

races.name: Willis Towers Watson Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Highly tried in juvenile hurdles last season and fit from a recent spin on the flat, MICHONNE looks the pick at the weights on return to maiden company. Hurdling debutant Bunker Buster showed bags of ability in bumpers and is feared most, with Gordon Elliott's Ivatt completing the shortlist.

  1. MICHONNE
  2. BUNKER BUSTER (IRE)
  3. IVATT

races.name: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Fairly-useful Flat performer COSMIC FRONT was undone by a bad mistake on her hurdles debut at Down Royal and is entitled to build on that. She gets the nod. The Captain's Word and Midfield Magic rate the principal dangers.

  1. COSMIC FRONT
  2. THE CAPTAIN'S WORD (IRE)
  3. MIDFIELD MAGIC (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Pat Walsh Memorial Mares Hurdle
races.verdict:
Last year's winner ROYAL HOLLOW has likely been aimed at a repeat bid and ran well on the Flat last month. She makes plenty of appeal. Daboya and Gino Bella are feared most.

  1. ROYAL HOLLOW (IRE)
  2. DABOYA (IRE)
  3. GINO BELLA (IRE)

races.name: 1xBet.ie Supports Safer Gambling Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOSSY WAY ran to a fair level in 2 maiden hurdles earlier in the year, jumping better on his second outing when third at Fairyhouse in April, and he can build on those efforts to open his hurdles account. Gillane arrives on the back of a bumper win and is next on the list, ahead of Euro Agent.

  1. MOSSY WAY (IRE)
  2. GILLANE (IRE)
  3. EURO AGENT (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This is wide open. LARKINS LANE took a step forward in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when a clear second in a big-field handicap at Kilbeggan last time and is weighted to go close off a 3 lb higher mark so edges the vote from hat-trick seeking Esticky End. Both No Big Deal and Getaway Charlie can also play a prominent role, while Mother Ship and At The Wings need factoring into this highly competitive handicap too.

  1. LARKINS LANE (IRE)
  2. ESTICKY END (IRE)
  3. NO BIG DEAL (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
COMANCHE MOON caught the eye on reappearance last season and it'll be interesting if he's supported this time around. He gets the nod over Hidalgo Des Mottes, who appeals on the best of his efforts, while Minority Interest could play a big role if the rain arrives. Talas Kera also needs a second look in a wide-open race, with several handicap debutants open to improvement, too.

  1. COMANCHE MOON (IRE)
  2. HIDALGO DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. MINORITY INTEREST (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Monaghan 90th Birthday Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for RIPSNORTER, who found significant improvement when scoring at Downpatrick last time and remains relatively unexposed. In For The Night and Ocean Murphy head the list of dangers.

  1. RIPSNORTER (FR)
  2. IN FOR THE NIGHT (IRE)
  3. OCEAN MURPHY

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mucklemeg Mares Flat Race (Listed)
races.verdict:
A hotly-contested listed bumper which looks sure to make for good form. ELEGANTEMENTE's debut win received a timely boost when the runner-up made all at Listowel last week, so she's put forward as the answer for all that she's presumably passed over by John Gleeson for stablemate Lola O C, who also impressed first time up at Roscommon. Long'way is the clear pick of the Willie Mullins trio, while Sarahs Lawn and Thelittleballerina are others to take seriously.

  1. ELEGANTEMENTE (FR)
  2. LOLA O C (IRE)
  3. LONG'WAY (FR)

races.name: Prix De La Chambre D'amour Stakes
Prix Jp. Loiseaux - Grande Course De Haies De Dax Handicap Hurdle
Grand Prix De La Ville De Dax Stakes
Prix Joseph De Laurens Handicap Chase
Prix De Conde Jockey Club De Turquie Stakes - Group 3
Qatar Arabian Trophy Des Poulains Stakes - Arab Group 1
Qatar Arabian Trophy Des Pouliches Stakes - Arab Group 1
Prix De Luneau Claiming Stakes - Awt
Prix De La Cepiere Handicap - Awt
Prix De Villeurbanne Claiming Stakes - Awt
Prix Des Camelias - Prix Geny Courses - Attele
